summary: Make shareable delivery a standard substantial-task completion gate
description: Add an explicit task delivery policy and automatically build a restricted immutable epic delivery when an approved substantial task requires one, while small/mechanical or opted-out work remains artifact-free.
acceptance: R-1: Task creation records shareable_delivery as auto, required, or none; auto classifies substantial agent work deterministically and remains backward compatible for older tasks.
R-2: Approving a required/substantial completed task automatically writes a restricted released delivery for its owning epic and records the delivery identity in review output/evidence.
R-3: Approval fails closed without leaving a falsely approved task when required delivery generation cannot resolve a unique epic or build a valid artifact.
R-4: Mechanical, small, explicitly none, and unchanged already-delivered work do not create noisy duplicate artifacts.
R-5: README and changelog document the standard completion behavior and override boundary.
verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_smoke.py -q -k 'shareable_delivery or automatic_delivery or task_review'
